product.name: Aerobex PulseBand 2.0
product.description: Aerobex PulseBand 2.0 delivers continuous heart‑rate monitoring and activity tracking in a sleek, lightweight design. The band features a flexible silicone strap and a high‑contrast OLED display that shows steps, calories, and sleep stages. Built‑in Bluetooth 5.2 syncs data to a companion app for trend analysis and coaching. A 500‑mAh rechargeable battery provides up to 10 days of use on a single charge, while a USB‑C port offers quick top‑ups. The device is water‑resistant up to 30 meters, making it suitable for workouts, swimming, and everyday wear.
